_comment: Demo step 2: what teams and departments agreed on over a month of using the agent (one older R&D / A meaning, link card problems, was last used in August 2005, so it has faded). scope=team: the team's shared meaning (enough teammates agreed). scope=department: the department's (enough of its teams agreed; `teams` lists them). taught_by and confirmed_by are kept as background signals. scope=personal: one person's own meaning of a term. Two departments (R&D through its team R&D / A, and Service) replaced the official 'incidents', so it shows as untrustworthy. Every department's meanings are visible to everyone.

items.meaning: correctable DDR memory errors plus cache parity errors and CE sym events: messages that contain 'ddr error' or 'parity error', or start with 'CE sym'
ciod socket errors between compute and I/O nodes: messages that start with 'ciod: Error reading message prefix' or 'ciod: failed to read message prefix'

a node card contains compute and I/O cards; its problems are events from component DISCOVERY, HARDWARE or MONITOR whose message mentions 'node card' (any capitalisation), plus every event with level FATAL or FAILURE whose location includes a node card, whatever its card type
rack R37, which produces by far the most events
every event with level FATAL or FAILURE, whether or not it has an alert label
any event from component LINKCARD, the cards that connect midplanes
FATAL kernel events, the ones that take a node down: level FATAL and component KERNEL
anything that ended a user's job: compute-node kernel panics and terminations (alert label KERNRTSP or KERNTERM) and core dumps (message template starts with 'generating core')
